description: Shape-feature branch: retrain the original square-root/local-noise sampled MLP with additional causal 3/6/12-week level, slope and curvature summaries, either unsmoothed or three-week smoothed. These summaries use only the available input history. Other model settings and weekly/path/peak losses are unchanged; no peak log loss. Each held-out fold trains on the other three seasons among 2022-23 through 2025-26, using finalized admissions and flu-ED histories and 36 future finalized weekly labels of both series. Two seeds 44/45. Evaluate on strict archived Wednesday reports in held-out 2024-25 and 2025-26, final NHSN peak labels, identical tasks to FluSight-ensemble. Retrospective development comparison, not untouched validation.
